name: Sodium chloride (NaCl), salt
source: NaCl molar mass 58.443 g/mol from IUPAC standard atomic weights (Na 22.990, Cl 35.453). Na fraction 22.990/58.443 = 39.3375%.
notes: Food-grade salt treated as the pure compound (anti-caking agents are a trace fraction and not tracked). Na is rounded to the nearest microgram; Cl closes the two-element compound exactly.
